modes.permissions: getter-only acquisition from an identified existing process/model; no selection, unit, lock, analysis, save or exit mutation
open an identified disposable copy and perform only the declared acquisition preparation/export
apply one declared transaction to an identified disposable copy and reanalyse under AO22

stages.acceptance: Target, runtime, model, capability, lease, completed analysis epoch and selected results are exact and current before the first result getter. Attached mode requires no setter capability.
Each call has a proved signature, successful return code, bounded shape and equal parallel-array lengths. Raw source-row identity is retained and partial canonical output is forbidden.
Convert once to PF4 units, retain six components from the same row, keep object/element identities separate and resolve physical face only from geometry/axis evidence.
Attached pre/post observed state is equal without issuing restore setters. Owned-copy work restores temporary state or returns restoration_unverified.

Timeout, broker loss, decode failure, state drift, lease loss or unmatched started call produces not_run, fenced, transaction_uncertain or restoration_unverified and prohibits automatic reconnect/replay.

deliverables.no_side_effect_rule: An attached target can never be promoted to owned within an operation. The original model is never a candidate mutation target.

acceptance_rules: A component envelope never substitutes for a concurrent interaction vector.
Complete_for_scope is impossible with a blocked row, unmatched exclusion approval, unresolved object/element mapping, unresolved axis/face, invalid unit conversion or stale/missing analysis epoch.
The snapshot digest covers all engineering-bearing fields, source evidence, row ledger, exclusions, mappings and normalized payload; only its own digest and presentation-only fields are excluded.
Consumers calculate, rank, report and replay without COM, ETABS, workbook mutation or source-model access.
Action rows declare static_concurrent, staged_step, response_result, component_envelope or design_envelope and operations enforce their accepted bases.

worksheet_functions.return_shape: scalar capacity/utilization or bounded diagnostic spill
scalar capacity/utilization or bounded diagnostic spill
scalar value/utilization or bounded check spill
scalar required value or bounded check spill
bounded station/result spill from explicit immutable input
bounded quantity/schedule summary from resolved current details

function_rules: A function is pure and deterministic over fully supplied scalar/range/serialized immutable input.
Thread-safe registration is allowed only when no Excel object model, COM, mutable static state, file, network, clock or ETABS process is touched.
Blank, zero, null and absent are converted according to PF4 before calculation.
Functions return semantic operation ID, input-cell/path mapping, result states, calculation identity and structured diagnostic code in scalar or spill form.
Functions cannot select an ETABS result, acquire COM data, write ranges, save/export files, start processes, mutate models, run long candidate search or record approval/currentness.
Large member design, optimization, reporting and application work run as commands with progress and cancellation rather than repeated cell calls.

commands.name: Import ETABS snapshot
commands.receipt: snapshot, acquisition/analysis identities, artifact hashes and limitations

commands.name: Calculate workbook
commands.receipt: input-table revision, controlled-range preimage, output revision, freshness ledger and row diagnostics

commands.name: Optimize beam
commands.receipt: domain/criteria/catalogue digests, explored count, cancellation/completeness and ranking

commands.name: Apply candidate to ETABS copy
commands.receipt: transaction, copy identity, dry-run digest, stage and reanalysis evidence

commands.name: Export calculation package
commands.receipt: result/detail/report IDs and output artifact hashes

commands.name: Measure/diagnose workbook
commands.receipt: workbook/XLL/runtime/machine IDs, samples, percentiles and workload revision

command_rules: Commands execute outside worksheet recalculation, use bulk table I/O and provide progress/cancellation.
Every controlled range write has preimage, write, readback and rollback evidence; failure cannot leave stale output marked current.
Only declared controlled tables are changed; user formulas, comments and unrelated sheets remain outside the command scope.

diagnostic_mapping.outcome: best-so-far only; no optimum or total-infeasibility claim

classes.consequence: reuse one immutable analysis revision but evaluate every required check
owned copy, new model/analysis revision, authorized dependency closure, new snapshot and comparison
not_run; resolve classification before evaluation or mutation

transitions: candidate_classified(reanalysis_required) -> copy_preflight_valid -> dry_run_valid -> setters_applied -> readback_valid -> analysis_started -> analysis_finished -> result_epoch_accepted -> snapshot_accepted -> candidate_evaluated -> ranked
interruption after a non-idempotent effect -> transaction_uncertain -> copy_quarantined
transaction_rules: The mutation transaction is single-use and non-idempotent; interruption records the latest durable stage and never automatically replays setter, analysis, save or exit.
Every setter has a dry-run old/new digest and readback before analysis.
The original model, attached process and immutable baseline remain untouched.
Selection requires PF7-qualified candidates; an incomplete candidate domain cannot produce an optimum claim.

deliverables.claim_boundary: Installed software behavior on the identified candidate/environment; not independent engineering proof, professional approval or release authorization.

scenarios.scenario: Excel function recalculation while ETABS is available
scenarios.pass: call ledger proves zero ETABS/COM/model/workbook-write/file calls; identical immutable input returns the same calculation identity/result
process/runtime/model/result selection/unit/lock pre/post equality; signed rows reconcile to raw evidence; no setter/save/unlock/analysis/design/exit
operation stops before force getter or returns not_run; source state is unchanged and no selection setter is hidden

scenarios.scenario: unit, array, mapping or axis failure
scenarios.pass: offline normalizer rejects the complete snapshot and emits no partial canonical member result
installed workbook/XLL/runtime identity, range preimage, saved/reopened readback, canonical reconstruction and freshness markers reconcile

scenarios.scenario: controlled workbook command fails during write
scenarios.pass: existing ranges restore exactly or new controlled sheets are removed; unrelated user content remains; rollback receipt is retained
candidate/check/ranking receipt binds the baseline analysis revision, no model mutation occurs and completeness semantics are correct
original/copy identities, old/new readback and original unchanged evidence; copy receives new result epoch/snapshot before comparison

scenarios.scenario: timeout or COM failure during owned-copy transaction
scenarios.pass: durable journal identifies interrupted stage, copy is quarantined, no automatic replay occurs and original remains unchanged
prior live evidence is not reused; new preflight must establish target/runtime/source/revision

deliverables.fake_host_rule: Mocks and fake Office hosts remain E1/E2 software evidence. They cannot satisfy any E5 scenario.

exit_evidence.criterion: Worksheet calculations need no live COM call or workbook mutation.
evidence: PF8-D3 limits functions to immutable inputs and pure operations; all host effects are explicit commands with receipts.

exit_evidence.criterion: ETABS actions preserve source identity and semantic classification.
evidence: PF8-D1/D2 retain acquisition/model/analysis/result, axes, object/element station, case/step, row identity and action basis through normalization.

exit_evidence.criterion: Stiffness-changing candidates require new analysis evidence.
evidence: PF8-D4 classifies coupled changes and requires owned-copy readback, reanalysis, a new result epoch and new snapshot before comparison.
